# Abdul Rahaman S  
Machine Learning Engineer | Data Scientist  
abdulabd1132000@gmail.com  
8939030306  
Chennai  
[linkedin.com/in/abdul-rahaman-s11](https://linkedin.com/in/abdul-rahaman-s11)  
[github.com/11abd](https://github.com/11abd)  

## Summary  
Results-driven Machine Learning Engineer and Data Scientist with extensive experience in developing and deploying machine learning models, particularly in the areas of deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), and model evaluation. Proven track record in designing end-to-end ML solutions and optimizing production ML systems in a B2B environment. Adept at translating complex system behaviors into robust learning pipelines, with a strong focus on scalability and performance. Actively seeking to leverage expertise in Python, AWS, and ML deployment to drive impactful AI solutions.

## Skills  
- **Languages:** Python, SQL  
- **Deep Learning & NLP:** TensorFlow, Keras, Transformers, LLM, RAG  
- **MLOps & Deployment:** MLflow, DVC, Docker, GitHub Actions, FastAPI, CI/CD  
- **Cloud & Systems:** AWS (S3, EC2, SageMaker), Azure (AZ-900, AZ-104), Git, PostgreSQL  
- **Machine Learning & Data Science:** Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Pandas, NumPy, Model Evaluation, Feature Engineering  

## Projects  
### Fraud Detection System – End-to-End MLOps Project  
*Technologies: Python, XGBoost, Scikit-learn, FastAPI, MLflow, Docker, GitHub Actions, SHAP*  
- Developed an XGBoost-based fraud classifier on imbalanced transaction data (~0.17% fraud rate), enhancing fraud recall compared to baseline models.  
- Implemented business-driven threshold tuning, achieving a balanced recall-precision ratio.  
- Attained high ROC-AUC scores (above 0.9) while prioritizing recall for fraud detection applications.  
- Integrated SHAP for feature-level explainability, ensuring transparency in model predictions.  
- Deployed a FastAPI inference service, utilizing Docker for containerization and automated CI checks with MLflow for experiment tracking.  

### RAG Chatbot (NLP / LLM Project)  
*Technologies: Python, FastAPI, Ollama, Sentence-transformers, ChromaDB*  
- Created a fully offline RAG system for answering queries based on PDFs and lecture videos.  
- Employed hybrid retrieval methods combining vector similarity (ChromaDB) and keyword-based scoring for improved response accuracy.  
- Built an idempotent ingestion pipeline featuring PDF parsing, Whisper-based transcription, chunking, and embeddings.  
- Integrated local LLM inference (Ollama) with strict context enforcement to minimize hallucinations, enhancing answer relevance.  

## Professional Experience  
### Ciklum (Pixellot AI Sports Production)  
**Support Engineer**  
Mar 2024 – Present | Chennai  
- Supported a large-scale sports production platform for global B2B clients, ensuring system reliability and performance.  
- Monitored system health using Grafana dashboards, proactively identifying anomalies to prevent downstream failures.  
- Diagnosed pipeline failures and data inconsistencies through detailed analysis of application and system logs.  
- Conducted acceptance testing for new installations, ensuring stability before client handover.  
- Collaborated with R&D teams to escalate critical issues, contributing to long-term system enhancements and reliability.  

### Infosys  
**System Engineer**  
Oct 2020 – Mar 2024 | Chennai  
- Resolved Windows OS and enterprise application incidents within SLA using ServiceNow, enhancing operational efficiency.  
- Managed patching, vulnerability remediation, and system administration across servers and workstations.  
- Provided support for Office 365 services, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.  
- Contributed to operational improvements through proactive monitoring and issue prevention strategies.  

## Certifications  
- AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C01)  
- ITIL V4 Foundation – Service Management Best Practices  
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)  
- Business Communication Excellence – Level 5  
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)  

## Education  
**University of Madras**  
Bachelor of Computer Applications  
2017 – 2020 | Chennai, India  

**Dhanalakshmi School**  
Higher Secondary  
2017 | Chennai
